fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The University of Manchester teaches its master's courses in the city of Manchester, on a single campus. Its one-year MSc Advanced Computer Science is the closest match to a Computer Science master's. The main thing to plan for is cost: international students pay **£41,400** in tuition for this course.

Two terms you will see below. IELTS is an English language test. CAS is the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies, the document a university issues so you can apply for a UK student visa.

| | MSc Advanced Computer Science |
|---|---|
| Length | **12 months**, full-time |
| Start | **September 2027** |
| Tuition for international students | **£41,400** a year |
| Deposit | **£2,500** |
| Application fee | None |
| English test (IELTS) | **7.0** overall, with no part below **6.5** |

## What it really costs

Your first year has four parts: tuition, a deposit, living money for your visa, and government fees.

**Tuition.** The fee is **£41,400** for the 12-month course, for entry in the academic year beginning September 2027.

**Deposit.** If you pay your own fees, you must pay a **£2,500** deposit. You pay it before your CAS is issued. The university takes it off your fees when you register, so it is not an extra cost.

**Living money.** For a UK student visa you must show you can support yourself. Manchester is outside London, so the rule is **£1,171 a month** for up to **9 months**. You must have this money for **28 days in a row**, and that 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the day you apply. This is money you show to the government, not a bill from the university.

**Visa fee.** The Student visa application fee from outside the UK is **£558**.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge is paid with your visa application. It is **£776 for each year of your visa**.

### First-year cost example: MSc Advanced Computer Science

| Item | How it is worked out | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Tuition | Full course fee | £41,400 |
| Living money | £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Visa application fee | Government fee | £558 |
| Health surcharge | £776 for each year of your visa | £776 or more |
| **Total** | £41,400 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 | **at least £53,273** |

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164.

This is an example, not a budget. The total below uses tuition only. Check the course page for how the deposit counts towards your fees. Living money is set by the visa rules, not by the university.

Read the rules in the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To compare costs at other UK universities, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Ways to reduce the cost

The main option is the **Global Futures Scholarship** for students domiciled in India. Domiciled means your permanent home is in India. The award is **£12,000**, given as a discount on the overseas tuition fee. You need an offer for a full-time, on-campus master's starting in 2027. This course meets that rule.

If you win it, tuition falls from £41,400 to **£29,400** (£41,400 − £12,000).

Manchester sends the scholarship form only after you get an offer. Submit the form by **25 April 2027**. Awards are made in two rounds: the first half by **15 March 2027**, and the rest by **1 June 2027**. Read the [India scholarships page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/) before you apply.

## What you need to get in

**English.** You need an IELTS score of **7.0** overall, with no part below **6.5**.

**Degree.** Check the course page for the degree rule. The 65% figure you may see there applies only to engineering degrees (BEng, BSc Eng and BTech).

**How you are assessed.** Manchester reviews applications in stages. Each stage has its own deadline and decision date, shown below. Apply early, because later stages depend on course places still being open.

## Deadlines

These dates are for entry in **September 2027**.

| Stage | Application received by | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **6 November 2026** | 8 January 2027 |
| 2 | **1 January 2027** | 5 March 2027 |
| 3 | **26 February 2027** | 30 April 2027 |
| 4 | **21 May 2027** | 18 June 2027 |

Later applications are considered depending on course availability. Applications for deferred entry are not accepted for this course.

Visa timing matters too. You can apply for a UK student visa up to **6 months** before your course starts. Government guidance says a decision usually takes **3 weeks** if you apply from outside the UK. The deposit comes before your CAS, so pay it early to keep your visa timeline on track.

## Related programs at Manchester

If you are comparing subjects, these master's courses sit close to Computer Science. Each lasts **1 year**. Fees vary for each master's course, so check each course page.

- [MSc Artificial Intelligence](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21574/)
- [MSc Cyber Security](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21575/)
- [MSc Machine Learning](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21576/)
- [MSc Software Engineering](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21577/)
- [MSc Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (Computer Science Data Informatics)](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/22195/msc-data-science-and-artificial-intelligence-computer-science-data-informatics/)

## Where you'll live

The university has a single campus, in the city of Manchester. The Accommodation Office lists rooms by hall. [Search accommodation](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/accommodation/student-accommodation/search/) to see what is available.

For 2025/26, the university's international accommodation page listed shared rooms from **£119 a week** (self-catering) to **£184 a week** (catered). Those prices were based on a **40 to 42 week** letting period. Check the search page for 2027-28 prices before you plan your budget.

Under the 2026-27 rules, international postgraduate students who come alone, pay the overseas fee rate and apply by **31 August** get a guaranteed offer of accommodation. You must also accept your place by **31 August**. The university says it will update the deadlines for 2027-28 entry in early 2027. See the [accommodation guarantee](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/accommodation/student-accommodation/guarantee/) page.

## Who it is a good fit for

**A strong choice if:**

- You want a 12-month, full-time Computer Science master's starting in September 2027.
- You can reach IELTS **7.0** overall, with no part below **6.5**.
- You can cover the first-year cost above, or you qualify for the Global Futures Scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- You cannot meet the stage deadlines, because later applications depend on course availability.
- You need to defer your start, because deferred entry is not accepted.
- Your English score is below 7.0 overall, or below 6.5 in any part.

## Sources

Checked on 3 November 2026:

- [MSc Advanced Computer Science course page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/courses/list/21573/msc-advanced-computer-science/): length, start, tuition, deposit, IELTS, deadlines and application fee.
- [International student fees](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/masters/fees-and-funding/international-student-fees/)
- [Global Futures Scholarship for India](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/country-specific-information/india/scholarships/)
- [Accommodation for international students](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/accommodation/)
- [Accommodation guarantee](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/accommodation/student-accommodation/guarantee/) and [international guarantee page](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/international/accommodation/guarantee/)
- [Accommodation search](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/study/accommodation/student-accommodation/search/)
- Government: [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Immigration Rules, Appendix Student](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student) and [Student visa money](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa/money)
- [Healthcare surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay)
- Related course pages, linked in the related programs section.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does the MSc Advanced Computer Science at Manchester cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Indian students pay the international fee of £41,400 for entry in September 2027. The course lasts 12 months. You also pay a £2,500 deposit. Check the course page for how it counts towards your fees.

faq_json.q: Is there an application fee for the MSc Advanced Computer Science at Manchester?
faq_json.a: No. This course has no application fee.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for the University of Manchester MSc Advanced Computer Science?
faq_json.a: You need an overall IELTS score of 7.0, with no part below 6.5.

faq_json.q: What is the application deadline for the MSc Advanced Computer Science in 2027?
faq_json.a: Applications are staged. Stage 1 closes on 6 November 2026 and Stage 4 closes on 21 May 2027. Later applications are considered depending on course availability.

faq_json.q: Can an Indian student get a scholarship for the Manchester MSc Advanced Computer Science?
faq_json.a: Yes, if you qualify for the Global Futures Scholarship. It is worth £12,000 and is a discount on the overseas tuition fee. Manchester sends the form after you get an offer, and you must submit it by 25 April 2027.

faq_json.q: Can I defer my place on the MSc Advanced Computer Science?
faq_json.a: No. Applications for deferred entry are not accepted for this course.
